newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 11 killed in clashes with Kurd rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 11 killed in clashes with Kurd rebels.

text.p: Eight Kurdish rebels and three members of the Turkish security forces were killed overnight in clashes in eastern Turkey, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Sunday.
The 11 died in fighting between troops and a group of Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas on Saturday night in the remote province of Bingol, the agency said.

It said rebel supplies were captured in a search after the clashes, in which three gendarmes died and two were injured. Search operations were continuing in the region, the agency quoted unnamed officials as saying.
On Monday, Turkish troops launched a major operation against the rebels, involving up to 40,000 troops backed by air power, in the neighbouring province of Tunceli.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old fight between the security forces and the PKK, which is fighting for self-rule in southeast Turkey.
